title: Skill directories for Ravel 2.0.0
intro: Directory delivery from local sources on the skill-directory-delivery line. The local stage is implemented, and acceptance remains ahead. Graph views start at the dark node labelled Start here, and numbered edge labels give the order of steps. The sequence starts at its first message. Ravel supplies directories, and the agent finds the skills. The specification docs/specs/skill-discovery.md is the authority for every rule drawn here.

discussion.title: Narrow skill sources to local directories
discussion.status: Owner decision recorded. The refusal of other source types is settled in the specification, and its implementation is ahead
discussion.summary: Ravel reads local source directories only. It runs no VCS command and makes no network request, and a tool outside Ravel installs and updates the checkouts. A settings record whose type is not local, such as git, refuses as settings_invalid, stage cli, exit 2, at skills.sources[N].type. Its remedy tells the owner to configure a local checkout.

updatedDiagrams.summary: Removed Git acquisition, so the Ravel CLI only captures local bytes. The settings node now names local sources.
Capture now reads the local tree, and the owner edits the source or its checkout instead of a pin.

diagrams.title: Prepare before the worker launches
diagrams.caption: No configured sources means no preamble and no cache work. A source failure refuses at stage skills, before the worker launches. The script puts request.prompt into the harness arguments and reads request.originalPrompt for task analysis. Mandatory reads precede caller actions, and callers qualify first accordingly.

diagrams.title: Where the prompt travels and which bound applies
diagrams.caption: The evaluate-frame bound is the sum of the public bounds at the largest JSON escape, so a request within those bounds fits. Ravel does not bound the kind, the working directory or the task-file path, so an exceptional value refuses as malformed_input before evaluation. The script result keeps its 1 MiB bound, and the platform argument limit can refuse less at launch.

diagrams.title: Keep the reader's directories
diagrams.caption: RAVEL_SKILL_DIRECTORIES keeps the same descriptor path, but it cannot keep an instruction to recover it. Whole-preamble loss needs an unprompted harness trial. Detached readers can outlive the managed group, and manual removal requires every affected reader to stop.

diagrams.title: Read resources and state the authority limit
diagrams.caption: The managed harness and each harness run receive the same read-only grants. Ordinary delegates can inherit the result context, and the instructions forbid them to use it. An adapter that controls the environment and grants removes that context, and a trial measures its isolation. Ravel cannot intercept arbitrary delegation interfaces of a harness.
